name: Desmopressin
mechanism: Synthetic ADH analogue increasing water reabsorption and factor VIII/vWF release
dosing: Diabetes insipidus: 10-40mcg intranasal BD or 100-200mcg PO TDS. Nocturnal enuresis: 200-400mcg PO at bedtime
contraindications: Hyponatraemia, cardiac insufficiency, conditions with fluid overload
interactions: Loop diuretics (↓ effect), tricyclics/NSAIDs (↑ hyponatraemia risk)
monitoring: Serum sodium (especially elderly and first week), fluid balance, urine output
pregnancy: Safe for diabetes insipidus - can be used in pregnancy
sideEffects: Hyponatraemia (potentially severe), headache, nausea, fluid retention
pharmacokinetics: Intranasal, oral or sublingual routes, half-life 3h
clinicalPearls: Monitor sodium closely - hyponatraemia risk especially with oral route and elderly. Fluid restrict while using
indication: Cranial diabetes insipidus, primary nocturnal enuresis (>7y), von Willebrand disease, mild haemophilia A
